description.label: Description
description.value:
Trivial Mental Mutation, Tolerable

You've become addicted to something, a guilty pleasure, that occupies a large share of your mind space: roll on the @Table[addiction] Table. You need to suppress (see @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.journal.JournalEntry.uDGFazW9Nr0N6ABS.JournalEntryPage.9sK84Dvy3Ng36qXp#self-control]{Self-Control}) your Addiction to avoid acting on it at inopportune times. The GM determines what the effects of giving in to your vice entails; lost time, a negative Fellowship modifier, or maybe some trouble that you stir up. The @Table[stinking-drunk] Table is a good source for inspiration.
